title: The AI That Answers 20,000 Calls a Day
content:
[TITLE: The AI That Answers 20,000 Calls a Day]

[HOOK: phone ringing SFX, face to camera]
20 THOUSAND customer calls a day...
aur unhe utha raha hai ek AI.

[SCREEN: x.ai - Introducing Grok Voice 3.0 | Oct 14, 2026 | Source: x.ai]
It's called Grok Voice 3.0.
Aur Starlink apne call center mein...
isi ko use karta hai.

[GRAPHIC: ~20,000 calls/day | ~70% resolved without a human | Source: x.ai (company-reported)]
According to the company...
roz lagbhag 20,000 calls.
Aur unme se lagbhag 70 PERCENT calls...
get solved without a single human.
Customer ko verify karna, hardware troubleshoot karna...
even shipping a replacement when needed.
Sab kuch AI khud karta hai.

[GRAPHIC: $0.08 per minute | Source: x.ai/news/grok-voice-3]
And the price?
Sirf 8 CENT per minute.
Yes, per minute. Calculator nikaalo aur khud socho.

[CAM: close-up]
That's Starlink.
Par ab apna business socho.
Clinic. Coaching centre. Shop. Any small business.
[B-ROLL: clinic, coaching centre, shop counter]
Every day, the same questions, again and again:
"Timing kya hai?"
"Fees kitni hai?"
"Mera order kahan hai?"
Aapka staff din bhar yahi jawab deta rehta hai.
And when the line is busy... the customer just leaves.

[SCREEN: simple flow - Call -> AI answers -> Human for hard cases]
This is where a voice agent comes in.
Repeat wale sawaalon ka jawab... AI de.
Aur jo MUSHKIL calls hain...
they go straight to your team.
Matlab aapka staff sirf wahi calls le...
jahan sach mein insaan ki zaroorat hai.
And they save time for the bigger work.

[CAM: face]
But listen carefully.
Ye numbers company ke APNE hain.
Every business is different.
Toh pehle apni calls pe TEST karo...
results dekho...
phir hi bharosa karo.
Don't deploy any tool without testing.

[CTA]
Aapke business ke liye aisa voice agent chahiye?
DM me 'AI'.
